details.1: Cross-course prerequisite & notation audit complete; removed a pre-Part-5 rank prerequisite leak from Lesson 7 and added shared inequality-preservation handling for math rendering.
details.2: Independent mathematics verification complete across Lessons 1-25; no additional confirmed arithmetic/method defect remained after the rendering correction.
details.3: Source-fidelity audit complete against the supplied NTU syllabus/O'Neil SI 8e; corrected stale Lesson 4 wording that falsely implied the entire Problems 7-23 bank was still included.
details.4: Difficulty/progression audit complete; teaching-to-transfer escalation is coherent and no further padding/reordering defect was confirmed.
details.5: Spaced-retrieval audit complete; added four delayed cumulative retrieval problems in Lessons 20 and 22 so Parts 1-4 reappear before the final review.
details.6: Full UI/interaction regression audit complete across all course screens at mobile and desktop sizes; navigation, quizzes, solution reveal, whiteboards, fullscreen, and overflow checks passed.
details.7: Persistence/sync stress audit complete. Confirmed and fixed a legacy startup isolation edge case: a remembered username without a scoped cache could fall back to a generic state owned by another profile before cloud reconciliation. Generic migration now requires matching ownership or a safe ownerless legacy state. Existing structural-equality save-loop protection, revision conflict merge, outgoing-profile flush/cache, anonymous isolation, online retry, and pagehide/visibility flush logic were rechecked and preserved.
details.8: Beginner-without-professor clarity audit complete. Course-wide language/acronym scan found no systemic skipped-reasoning pattern; added explicit first-use definitions for undetermined coefficients (UC), variation of parameters (VP), and linear time-invariant (LTI) before later shorthand use. No cosmetic rewrites were made where reasoning was already shown.
details.9: Exam-readiness/syllabus-skill-matrix audit complete. Midterm boundaries remained correct; the cumulative final review underrepresented several Part 1-2 selection outcomes, so four targeted diagnostics were added for first-order method selection, reduction of order versus variation of parameters, BVP compatibility, and engineering-model formulation.
details.10: Performance/maintainability audit complete. No risky persistence/whiteboard refactor was justified. Confirmed stale cache-busting version tags across lesson/mobile assets and normalized them to the current audited release so returning browsers request current scripts. Existing all-lesson deferred loading was left intact because changing boot architecture would create disproportionate regression risk without a confirmed functional defect.
